description: This Java class configures ActiveMQ messaging components for the Fineract notification system, including connection factory, JMS template, and message listener container with exception handling.

classes.name: MessagingConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up ActiveMQ messaging components, including connection factory, JMS template, and message listener container with exception handling.

methods.name: loggerBean
methods.description: Creates and returns a Logger instance for this class.

methods.name: amqConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures an ActiveMQConnectionFactory with a default or environment-specified broker URL.

methods.name: connectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a CachingConnectionFactory wrapping the ActiveMQConnectionFactory.

methods.name: jmsTemplate
methods.description: Creates a JmsTemplate using the connection factory.

methods.name: messageListenerContainer
methods.description: Sets up a DefaultMessageListenerContainer with connection factory, destination, message listener, and exception handling.
